changes: New control execution order: train to matched horizon, freeze budget from costs only before evaluation, primary final evaluation, collect/analyze and immutable report snapshot, then global all-cohort gate, extension, budget endpoint evaluation, final report.

Keep original bindings/configs/trainers, checkpoint/optimizer/RNG/reward history and old plans/evaluation tasks. Primary evaluation reuses original evaluation keys/results; no duplicate completed evaluation.

Global gate checks durable per-cohort receipt/source binding/frozen budget hashes. Failed/unavailable cohort prevents extensions; other primary results stay saved and workers exit with an explicit deferred error once only blocked extensions remain.

Old extension/evaluation/complete queues are redirected only after live task leases release; failure evidence retained. All historical Runtime numerical code stays pinned, current control wrappers provide primary phases. All workers need updated restart; old frozen workers continue old order.

controls.metrics: All four cohorts produce primary reports before earliest extension; hashes of every preserved report file verified; budget freeze before primary evaluation; stale extension offer blocked; live lease/binding/old plans and failed budget evaluation preserved; missing cohort exits without erasing successful primary report
controls.checkpoint_provenance: All30 frozen trainer SHA256 unchanged; no real H100 checkpoint or original model file touched; retained model/optimizer/RNG and per-update training reward curves unchanged
controls.historical_compatibility: All32 shipped original Runtime variants expose required metadata hooks; wrappers preserve original training plan and prior V8-016 budget fix

limitations: No actual H100 progress/timing/accuracy/idle measurements. Old running workers must be restarted on all nodes to apply this control-order change. Running tasks are not preempted by metadata migration and already completed extensions cannot be reordered retroactively. A failed cohort blocks extension but does not erase other primary results. Extension endpoint evaluation still necessarily follows extension.
